sections.title: Profile
sections.description: A short overview of my experience, main technology stack, and key achievements as an iOS engineer. Selected highlights from my production work follow it.
sections.profile: Senior iOS Engineer, 8+ years in production apps: e-commerce, crypto trading, fintech, healthcare. Main stack – Swift, SwiftUI/UIKit, Swift Concurrency, Combine. Led three architecture migrations (RxSwift → Combine → async/await), built one app from scratch as the only iOS developer, set up modular SPM codebases and release tooling. Apps I worked on last held crash-free rate above 99.8%.
highlights: Wrote shell scripts for release branches, version bumps and TestFlight uploads – no third-party CI/CD needed. Together with a strict git flow this meant a release could be cut from the dev branch at any moment. The main win was not only speed but fewer human errors: version numbers, tags, commits and release notes were always correct.
Migrated production codebases through three generations: UIKit/RxSwift → UIKit/Combine → SwiftUI + Swift Concurrency.
Shipped on-device image classification (TensorFlow) that checks whether a photo is a supported Ukrainian passport type in a banking onboarding flow.

Use AI coding agents daily: wrote Claude Code skills for refactoring and enforcing the team's code style at MAUDAU; set up Codex in VS Code with custom extensions for building and Swift syntax support at Loca; use agents for code review, test generation and migrations.
